risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to interest rate risk with respect to its debt obligations as disclosed in Item 1A and Note 5 of the 10-K.
risks.summary: The company is exposed to fluctuations in interest rates, which may impact its ability to refinance debt and affect financing costs.

risks.title: Inventory Management Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company maintains significant inventories which present risk in case of demand or supply variations; recent write-offs noted in fiscal 2025.
risks.summary: The company must efficiently manage inventories to avoid losses in case of demand fluctuations or supply chain disruptions.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risks due to its international operations across Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific regions.
risks.summary: The company must manage currency exposure to mitigate potential losses from adverse foreign exchange rate fluctuations.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company carries significant debt levels which represent risk in case of financial distress or inability to meet debt obligations.
risks.summary: The company must effectively manage its debt to ensure timely repayment and maintain financial stability.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in medical devices and healthcare sectors, with non-compliance risks.
risks.summary: The company must maintain compliance with evolving healthcare and medical device regulations to avoid sanctions and financial losses.

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to operational risks from manufacturing, supply chain, and global business disruptions.
risks.summary: The company must manage operations effectively to minimize losses from manufacturing disruptions or supply chain failures.
